_about: dimethyl-carbonate (1) + n-nonane (2): the two liquids in equilibrium measured in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive's records (bulk file ThermoML.v2020-09-30.tgz), by validation/python/two_liquid_survey.py --classes (proposal 0019, step 2). Rows: T in K, P in kPa (null where the record gives none), mole fraction of component 1 in liquid I and in liquid II, index of the record in records.

records.citation: M. Huang, Z. Chen, T. Yin, X. An, W. Shen, Critical Behavior of Binary Mixtures of Dimethyl Carbonate + Nonane and Dimethyl Carbonate + Dodecane: Measurements of the Coexistence Curves, J. Chem. Eng. Data 56 (2011) 2349-2355
records.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
